Slide.title: Slide
Slide.description: Represents a custom video slide for the Snap Shots portfolio carousel.

slideIndex.description: Zero-based index of the portfolio slide (0-20).

videoUrl.description: Public URL of the video stream or MP4 asset.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the slide was last updated.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: A client booking request for photography or videography services.

clientName.description: Full name of the client making the booking.

phone.description: Contact phone number or WhatsApp number.

service.description: Selected service (e.g. Wedding Reels, Event Reels).

package.description: Selected package (e.g. Hourly Plan, Half Day Plan).

eventDate.description: Date of the scheduled shoot or event.

city.description: Location or city for the shoot.

requirements.description: Additional notes, styling preferences, or brief from the client.

status.description: Current status of the booking enquiry.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the booking request was submitted.

TestConnectionProbe.title: TestConnectionProbe
TestConnectionProbe.description: Health check document used to verify Firestore connectivity.

/slides/{slideId}.description: Customized video slides displayed in the portfolio carousel.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Customer booking enquiries submitted through the booking modal or contact form.
